text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uugh... I'm really, really, really sorry! I
lost the
race...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I g-gave it my best shot, but I couldn't
move the
way I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It was only for a second, but... I thought
this was
the end for me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I do... the fact I was about to lose hope
is what I
hate more than anything!
